verdict.rationale: Recruitee is an ATS SaaS, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair axis to judge. The only related evidence is a bare 'AI & Automation' feature heading. Nothing documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to; the rest of the pack covers APIs, webhooks and feeds.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
